product: Semiconductor production equipment: coaters/developers with over 90 percent share, plasma etch, cleaning, deposition, advanced-packaging bonders and debonders and probers including Prexa SDP, plus Field Solutions parts, services and used equipment.
demand: Driven by AI data centers; management sees WFE at USD 150B+ in CY2026 and USD 190B+ in CY2027, with AI data-center WFE exceeding 50 percent of the total. Q1 FY2027 net sales were a record 732.3B yen, up 33.3 percent YoY.
pricing_power: Very strong in coaters/developers at over 90 percent share and in DRAM capacitor etch, but pricing was historically a headwind. Management calls price optimization a near-term issue, with contribution expected from H2 FY2027 and effects visible in Q4.
competition: Competition is intensifying and an analyst noted TEL share declined over recent years, which management attributes mainly to FX. Main rivals are Lam Research, Applied Materials, Screen Holdings, Kokusai Electric and Hitachi High-Tech, plus BESI, ASMPT and Tokyo Seimitsu in packaging and probing.
team: President and CEO Toshiki Kawai, COO Hiroshi Ishida and CFO Hiroshi Kawamoto lead; organization and representative-director changes were announced 2026-06-23 and 2026-09-15, with 20,236 employees.
market_strategy: The medium-term plan targets net sales of at least 3T yen, OPM of at least 35 percent and ROE of at least 30 percent by March 2027, via five profitability initiatives, SAM expansion, a Miyagi plant to triple etch capacity by summer 2027, a 5-for-1 split, a Level I ADR and a 150B yen buyback.
bull: Q1 FY2027 record sales 732.3B yen, +33.3% YoY, OP 211.4B; H1 guidance raised to 1,620B and interim DPS to 384 yen (2026-07-30, primary). Coat/develop +50%, advanced packaging +70% YoY on AI data-center WFE.
bear: Shares fell ~25% in three months to 56,520, ~30% below the 81,260 high. Q2 gross and operating margins guided lower on mix and fixed costs; 35% OPM target still In Progress; analyst cited years of share decline.
falsifier: FY2027 Q2 earnings on 2026-10-30 showing gross margin below Q1 FY2027 and no H2 recovery, or H1 net sales under the raised 1,620B yen guidance.
web_what_changed: 2026-07-30 Q1 FY2027 record net sales 732.3B yen, up 33.3 percent YoY, OP 211.4B yen, H1 guidance raised to 1,620B yen from 1,570B and interim DPS to 384 yen; 2026-07-16 NVIDIA collaboration expanded; 2026-08-03 150B yen buyback completed; 2026-09-17 Level I ADR TELWY launched; 5-for-1 split effective 2026-10-01.
web_not_known_yesterday: No company disclosure dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 was found; the newest primary item remains the 2026-09-17 sponsored ADR launch. The stock closed 2026-09-25 at JPY 56,520, up 4.82 percent, on aggregator data.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Growth is demand and volume led, from AI data-center spending on leading-edge logic and memory. Q1 FY2027 mix: coaters/developers +50 percent YoY, etch +25 percent YoY, advanced packaging +70 percent YoY; DRAM 32, non-volatile memory 11, non-memory 57 percent. Price optimization contributes only from H2 FY2027, visible in Q4.
web_suppliers: Not named individually in the primary documents. Management says its strength is a supply chain established in Japan and that it prepares capacity together with suppliers; as of 2026-07-30 it reported no supply-chain or Middle East issues, only close monitoring.
web_customers: Individual customers are not named in TEL filings. Q1 FY2027 sales by region: China 30.4 percent, Taiwan 25.4 percent, South Korea 20.8 percent, Japan 8.8 percent, North America 8.1 percent, Europe 3.3 percent; FY2027 China is guided to the low 30s percent, showing high geographic concentration.
web_who_loses: Equipment rivals lose share and pricing power: Lam Research and Applied Materials in etch/deposition, Screen Holdings in coaters and cleaning, Kokusai Electric and Hitachi High-Tech in deposition/etch, and BESI, ASMPT, Tokyo Seimitsu and Advantest in advanced packaging and probing.
web_contradicting_evidence: The shares fell about 25 percent in three months, from JPY 75,340 to 56,520, and sit roughly 30 percent below the 52-week high of 81,260. Q2 FY2027 gross and operating margins are guided lower on mix and fixed costs; the 35 percent OPM target is still In Progress, and an analyst cited years of share decline.
web_if_management_right: WFE reaches USD 150B+ in CY2026 and 190B+ in CY2027; H1 FY2027 net sales of 1,620B yen and a stronger H2; FY2027 operating profit of 1T yen comes into view; gross margin reaches 50 percent in early FY2028; the Miyagi plant triples etch capacity from summer 2027.
web_if_management_wrong: H2 momentum or price optimization fails, so the Q2 margin decline persists and the 1T yen operating profit and 35 percent OPM targets slip. Memory or China capex reverses, or a yen move and Middle East supply-chain disruption hit reported sales and share.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: TEL Japanese component and supply-chain vendors, smart-fab and Miyagi construction and automation suppliers, NVIDIA through Epsira, Isaac and Omniverse, JPMorgan as ADR depositary and Mizuho as local custodian, and the parts, service and used-equipment ecosystem.
